control: Bank and card statements for the full period received
evidence_required: statement files with opening and closing balances covering every day of the period

control: Sales invoice credit and refund list through cutoff received
evidence_required: invoice register or billing export with row count and total

control: Bills receipts and expense claims through cutoff received
evidence_required: bills export and receipt files with count and total

control: Payroll report received
evidence_required: approved payroll register for the period

control: Loan transfer and owner-account statements received
evidence_required: lender and savings statements for the period

control: Processor reports received (Stripe PayPal Square)
evidence_required: payout reconciliation or activity report for the period in the statement time zone

control: Bank and card statements reconciled
evidence_required: workpaper per account from statement-reconciliation with status and owner sign-off

control: Sales invoices complete through cutoff; credits and refunds recorded
evidence_required: invoice register total tied to the billing export; credits listed

control: Bills receipts expenses and employee claims complete through cutoff
evidence_required: expense review table with ready-to-post and needs-review totals

control: Receivables and payables aged; disputes and stale items listed
evidence_required: aging tables at cutoff with disputes and stale items

control: Payroll records received and tied to approved payroll reports
evidence_required: payroll register net pay and tax deposits tied to bank lines

control: Processor clearing reconciled
evidence_required: payout breakdown with every payout tied or in transit

control: Opening Balance Equity zero or routed to the accountant
evidence_required: OBE balance at cutoff and exception id if not zero

control: Bills not yet received checked (cutoff)
evidence_required: list of expected recurring bills and suppliers with no bill for the period

control: Loans interest transfers and owner or intercompany items reconciled
evidence_required: lender balance tied to ledger liability; transfers matched both sides

control: Undeposited Funds and suspense at zero or explained
evidence_required: balance at cutoff with each item explained or raised as an exception

control: Owner sign-off recorded on each bank reconciliation
evidence_required: approvals.csv row per reconciliation workpaper

control: Fixed-asset accrual prepayment tax and revenue-policy items sent to the accountant
evidence_required: accountant hand-off list with source for each candidate

control: Profit-and-loss and balance movements reviewed against prior period and plan
evidence_required: draft P&L brief with basis and currency and open items

control: Every proposed adjustment has a source reason preparer and approver
evidence_required: adjustment list with approvals.csv references

control: Period lock date recorded (owner or ledger admin locks in their own system)
evidence_required: lock date as stated by the owner
